offer: Online booking, SMS reminders and a same-day waitlist for clinics with two to ten doctors. PHP 2,400 per clinic per month, every doctor and every front-desk seat included. Patient records export in the PhilHealth claims format. Fourteen day trial, no card needed.
audience: Clinic owners and front-desk staff in Philippine cities who run appointments from a paper logbook and a Viber group, lose an hour a day to no-shows and reschedules, and have been burned by software that needed a consultant to set up.
voice: Calm, exact, no startup energy. Explains what happens on Monday morning, not what the platform enables. Numbers over adjectives. Never says seamless, streamline or empower.
facts: Used by 63 clinics across Metro Manila, Cebu and Davao
No-show rate across those clinics fell from 18 percent to 7 percent after SMS reminders went live
Set-up takes one afternoon; the front desk keeps the paper logbook for the first week
A same-day waitlist fills a cancelled slot in a median of 22 minutes
Data is stored in a Singapore data centre and exported on request, no lock-in
imagery: a clinic reception in Quezon City at half past seven in the morning before opening, chairs empty, one phone on the desk, blinds half open
a doctor's desk with a monitor turned away from the camera, a stethoscope and a paper logbook, late afternoon light
